Two solid cylinders, P and Q, are shown, where $x > y$.
Cylinder P has diameter $x$ and height $y$.
Cylinder Q has diameter $y$ and height $x$.
What is the positive difference between the total surface areas of P and Q?

assets.alt: Cylinder P has diameter $x$ and height $y$. Cylinder Q has diameter $y$ and height $x$. The diagram shows two solid cylinders, P and Q, with their respective dimensions.
